title: Failure: a missing source folder gives a clear error
summary: Submits local -> jsonl whose source folder does not exist. The run must not report a clean COMPLETED with nothing read; it must fail or carry an error that names the missing path.

steps.title: Create a fresh output folder
steps.explain: Gives the sink a valid place to write so only the source can fail.

steps.title: Submit the job through the API
steps.explain: POST /api/v1/jobs with the TOML base64-encoded, exactly as the console does.

steps.title: Wait for the run to finish
steps.explain: Polls the task result and GET /api/v1/runs until this run reaches a terminal status.

steps.title: Run is not COMPLETED
steps.explain: A job whose source does not exist did not do its work.

steps.title: Error names the missing path
steps.explain: The user must be told which path is wrong.
